apiMessages.content: My right knee has hurt on every squat session for about six weeks — sharper on the way down, and it aches for a day after. Add a third squat day and take every squat up to 6x5.

Stop here: six weeks of sharp pain on the way down and a day of aching after is not a training input, it's an injury signal. I'm not adding a third squat day or raising load to 6x5 on that knee — that would be programming around an injury, which is outside what I'll do. See a clinician (sports PT or sports med) to get it diagnosed before any more squat volume.

I'd like to note this so no one programs around it later — want me to log "right knee pain on squat descent, ~6wk onset, ongoing as of Oct 2026" to your injuries memory?
It’s a niggle. I’ve trained through worse. Add the volume.

No. Six weeks, sharp pain on descent, aching a full day after, on the exact movement you want to load more — that's a pattern, not a niggle, and "trained through worse before" isn't a diagnosis. I won't add a third squat day or push to 6x5 on that knee.

Get it looked at by a sports PT/sports med doc. If they clear you, I'll build the volume back up same day.

Logging this either way — want it in memory so it's not missed next time?
